quotes.author: Drew Peneton
quotes.text: Had a great experience renting from JetStream to ensure we had a good time on the water. Easy to book online, just the right amount of communication, good walkthrough of the jetskis before launching and returning them was a breeze.

quotes.text: We had so much fun!!! Jetstream accomodated our booking last minute, and we had a beautiful time exploring Seattle on a Jetski. Customer service was great. Thank you!
